title: Gham Mein Dooba Hooa Karbal ka
body:
Gham mein Dooba hooa karbal ka musafir dheka
Rotay Shabbir ko Zahra ki lehad par dheka
<<DIVIDER>>
Apne sar maar ke deewar se roya Ghazi
Jab nabi zaadi ko aathe hooe bahar dhekha
<<DIVIDER>>
Noor ankhon ka gaya qatilon se pooche Hussain
Koi batlaye kisi ne mera Akbar dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
Ravi likhte hai ke sajjad ko jab hosh aya
Jalthe khaiyyam me zainab ko khule sar dheka
<<DIVIDER>>
Door tak pehli hai qasim ki javani run mein
Dheyr tak doondhtha phir Sibte Payamber dheka
<<DIVIDER>>
Mujh ko barbad khuda kerde ye bola paani
Sheh ke hathon me jo zakhmi ali asghar dehka
